prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Save Your Companion Profile", "Create or sign in to your account now so your newly adopted companion state is safely saved to the cloud."]
1: ["Setting Up Your Desktop Sanctuary", "While your companion gets ready, set up its desktop arrival preferences.", "Configure Sanctuary", "Design Desktop Arrival Zone", "Choose where your pet first lands on screen and set default quiet hours.", "Save & Continue"]
2: ["Official Pet Adoption Record", "Confirm your desktop companion's name and official traits before completing adoption.", "Pet Name", "Verified Companion"]
3: ["Welcome Your Desktop Pet", "Your companion is ready! Next, let's quickly review how to interact with your pet on desktop.", "View Control Guide", "Desktop Gesture Controls Guide", "Right-click your companion on desktop to trigger options, hide, or open talk mode.", "Start Playing"]
4: ["Discover Your Desktop Companion Journey", "Swipe through companion paths to choose the experience that matches your routine.", "Explore creative, quiet, or interactive pet playstyles."]
5: ["Protect Your Pet's Memory", "Sign in to activate cloud backup so your pet's traits and progress are safely preserved across logins.", "Cloud Save Active"]
6: ["Upload Custom Pet Reference", "Select clear photos for optimal custom pet rendering results.", "For best quality, upload well-lit photos without heavy background clutter.", "Tips: Well-lit front-facing photos yield best rendering accuracy."]
7: ["Preparing Your Custom Companion", "We are generating high-resolution desktop animations for your pet."]
8: ["Your Companion Has Arrived on Desktop!", "Look at the bottom-right corner of your screen! Click and drag your companion to place it anywhere on your desktop.", "Got It, Let's Go!"]
9: ["Begin Your Companion Selection", "Follow these quick steps to customize and invite your new companion to your desktop."]
